text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. After working up a good sweat,
nothing beats an extra hot bath at my usual bathhouse.
That stuff really is in a league of its own!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the big idea, bath attendant?!
This water's totally lukewarm, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Bathhouse Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about this, Inari-chan.
Looks like it's busted...
The repairman's coming tomorrow, though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Gah! An ice-cold cold bath
would be way better than this!
The gods sure can be merciless..."
